name: Upload an invoice PDF to bimetrics and check its processing status

parameters.content:
# Upload an invoice PDF to bimetrics and check its processing status

### Who is this for?

Teams using self-hosted n8n that already have an invoice PDF and want to send it to bimetrics for bookkeeping preparation.

### How it works

The workflow reads one existing PDF, uploads it through the bimetrics API, then checks its processing status. It makes one upload request and up to six status requests, five seconds apart while processing is pending.

The result includes the document ID, processing outcome and a suggested next step. Check `outcome`: a completed n8n execution can also report a quota pause, processing failure or polling limit. Review the invoice data in bimetrics afterward.

### Setup

1. Use self-hosted n8n with access to the PDF on its server. In Docker, mount the file into the container.
2. Have API access for your company in a paid bimetrics plan, with `upload` and `read` permissions.
3. Fill in the file path, PDF filename and stable source document ID in **Set upload inputs**.
4. In both HTTP Request nodes, select the same Header Auth credential: header `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
5. Start manually and inspect the result.

For a retry, retain the same company, key, source ID, file, filename and upload field. Use a new ID for a new document. Upload errors stop without automatic retry.

Tested locally with n8n 2.40.7. The test verified transport and status handling; real OCR accuracy was not tested. This template does not fetch supplier portals or approve bookings.

[Setup and troubleshooting (German)](https://bimetrics.de/ratgeber/n8n-buchhaltung) · [API reference (German)](https://developer.bimetrics.de/beleg-upload)

## 1. Configure and upload
Set the three input fields and select credentials in both HTTP nodes.

## 2. Check processing status
Read up to six times. Check outcome before continuing; completion is not approval.
